entries.1856549e1747a462: A specialty steel manufacturer that makes and sells specialty steel, stainless steel, magnets, forged products and other products for automobiles and industrial machinery.
entries.189768bba7fc4cc3: This business consists of service operations such as real estate, insurance and employee welfare, and of import and export of group products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,031 million. The business also includes analysis services, information system development and operation, and golf course management.

entries.491a0db68c64bd5c: This business manufactures and sells steel-related equipment, industrial furnaces and environment-related equipment, and also provides maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,625 million, an increase of 10.6% from the prior fiscal year. Sales of melting equipment for steel production and maintenance parts increased.
entries.6c21d25d60415c24: This business manufactures and sells stainless steel, high-alloy materials, magnets, titanium, powder materials and other products. These serve as materials for automobiles, industrial machinery, and electrical and electronic components. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥199,753 million. Stainless steel for HDD (hard disk drives) used in data centers increased, and magnets with the distinctive feature of not using heavy rare earths (such as dysprosium) also saw demand pick up. Titanium products saw lower revenue as inventory adjustments related to medical applications continued.

entries.b3b809f9a8ad605c: This business manufactures and sells special steels (steel with components and properties adjusted to suit each use), such as structural steel and tool steel, mainly for automobiles and industrial machinery, and is the largest business in the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥207,781 million. Structural steel volumes increased as demand from industrial machinery gradually recovered, while tool steel volumes decreased as demand from automobiles was weak. Manufacturing and sales are handled by the company and Nippon Koshuha Steel Co., Ltd., while distribution and secondary processing are handled by Daido DM Solution Co., Ltd. and others.

entries.d24e1800216d98ac: This business manufactures and sells parts for automobiles and industrial machinery, including die forgings, free forgings, cast steel and precision castings, and engine valves. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥117,937 million, an increase of 4.3% from the prior fiscal year. Engine valves increased in demand in North America and elsewhere, and precision castings increased for turbo-related applications. Die forging volumes decreased due to lower demand related to automobiles and trucks.
